rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Floribunda.
Registration name: WEKebtigrad
Exhibition name: Celestial Night ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Christian Bédard (United States, before 2015).
Introduced in United States by Spring Hill Nurseries in 2017 as 'Celestial Night'.
rows.Bloom: Purple, white undertones. Plum purple. Moderate, fruity, spice fragrance. 48 to 82 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), in small clusters, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Rounded. Glossy, dark green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 3' to 4' (90 to 120cm). Width: 2' to 3' (60 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for cut flower or landscape. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant.
